description: Hand-written retrieval evaluation set (T16). 15 questions across topics with the MedlinePlus pages that should be found and short facts that should appear in the retrieved text; plus questions the corpus cannot answer, used to check the no-context threshold. 'facts' use | for alternatives and are matched case-insensitively.
